and related land resources commissions; and

section 201 of the Water Resources Planning Act (42 U.S.C,. 1962b),  
and as President of the United States, it is ordered as follows :

the Ohio River Basin Commission is established under the provisions of  
Title II of the Water Resources Planning Act (42 U .S.C . 1962b et seq.).

section 1  of this order shall extend to those portions of the States of Ken­
tucky, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, N ew  York, North Carolina, Ohio,  
Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Virginia, and West Virginia that are located  
.within the Ohio River drainage basin, excluding the Tennessee River  
drainage basin.
